author: Huawei
description:
From advanced networks to the digital transformation of industry, the promise of artificial intelligence is everywhere.

At the #Huawei #TECHcares Forum, Delia Fischer, Chief Communications Officer of IMD Business School, highlighted a growing concern: in the race to build an AI-powered future, are we also building a wider digital divide? In her #TransformTalks interview, Delia points beyond access and unveils a more profound question: how can we educate people not only to use AI, but to shape it?

Watch to discover more from Transform Talks: https://bit.ly/4uMvLiB #DigiTruck #MWC26 #ThisIsHuawei
title: AI Could Widen the Digital Divide – Unless We Act
